segments.name: Broker Dealer & Intellectual Property Service
segments.description: Runs a self-clearing broker-dealer for private and public securities offerings and offers patent research for investment banking due diligence.
segments.evidence: The broker dealer & intellectual property service segment currently has two subsidiaries, Public Ventures and PatentVest.

segments.name: Technology Development
segments.description: Develops early-stage synthetic biology and small molecule senescence platforms through research and development subsidiaries.
segments.evidence: The technology development segment currently has two subsidiaries, eXoZymes, and M1.

revenueModel.text: The broker-dealer earns fee income from investment banking activities such as advisory services and capital raising, and PatentVest earns fees for patent research.
revenueModel.evidence: Includes fee income generated for the broker-dealer from investment banking activities, including advisory services, capital raising, and other related financial transactions.

changes.text: eXoZymes was deconsolidated in 2024 and is now accounted for under the equity method.
changes.evidence: As a result, effective November 14, 2024, eXoZymes became a minority owned company and is now accounted for under the equity method of accounting.
